SUAS-002 — System Glyph Width & Monospace Grid

The second SuperUnicode Architecture Standard: East_Asian_Width-style width classification and O(1) fixed-cell grid metric.

SUAS-002 (SGW) is the second SuperUnicode Architecture Standard. It defines an East_Asian_Width-style (UAX #11) width classification over the full 64-bit SUCS space (sucs_ex_char_t), folded into an O(1) monospace grid contract (0/1/2 cells + column cursor) for terminal emulators and CJK/ideographic framebuffer consoles.

Width classes

Six width classes are defined, mirroring the UAX #11 categories:

  • F (Fullwidth) — characters that are always wide.
  • H (Halfwidth) — characters that are always narrow (e.g. U+20A9 ₩).
  • W (Wide) — characters that are wide in East Asian context (e.g. Han ideographs, Emoji_Presentation).
  • Na (Narrow) — characters that are always narrow (e.g. U+00A5 ¥).
  • A (Ambiguous) — characters whose width depends on context (e.g. U+212B Å, U+01D4).
  • N (Neutral) — characters that do not occur in East Asian text (e.g. U+00C5 Å, U+01D3).

Zone dispatch

  1. Unicode Bridge 0x00000000–0x0010FFFF — curated EAW table.
  2. SCP 0x00110000–0x0011FFFF — non-advancing control, grid 0.
  3. Native SUCS 0x00120000–0x7FFFFFFE — single cell.
  4. ExtSUCS >0x7FFFFFFF — single cell.
  5. Trap 0x7FFFFFF0–0x7FFFFFFE / Sentinel 0x7FFFFFFF — grid 0.

Key rules

  • U+20A9 ₩ = H, U+00A5 ¥ = Na, U+00C5 Å = N, U+212B Å = A.
  • U+01D4 = A, U+01D3 = N.
  • Han ranges = Wide (including unassigned).
  • Emoji_Presentation = Wide except Regional_Indicator (U+1F1E6..1F1FF).
Feature Status
Six width classes F/H/W/Na/A/N Yes
O(1) grid cell + column advance Yes
Zero heap allocation Yes
64-bit extSUCS zone dispatch Yes
Ambiguous contextual resolution Yes
Emoji_Presentation→Wide except Regional_Indicator Yes
Tailoring override hook Yes

Reference implementation: include/suas/suas_sgw.h + src/suas/suas_sgw.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suas_static.

Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-002-sgw.md in the repository.
